data:
I went for the sonography to verify if there are any other internal organs that look suspicious.

I got the results 20 minutes after the procedure. So far, everything inside me looks OK.

  • ✔ Pancreas.
  • ✔ Liver.
  • ✔ 2 x Kidney.
  • ✔ Bladder.
  • ✔ Gallbladder.
  • ✔ Appendix.
  • ✔ Prostate.

So far, so good.
